summary: Frontend testing completed for Aristocratic Artwork Sale dark theme redesign. All 10 test cases passed successfully. The elegant dark purple/gold color scheme is properly implemented across all pages.

home_page_dark_theme.details: Body background is rgb(5, 5, 5), hero has purple gradient (rgb(36, 0, 70))

navigation_dark_background.details: Navbar background is rgba(5, 5, 5, 0.85) with backdrop blur

navigation_gold_hover.details: Nav links change from rgb(156, 163, 175) to rgb(212, 175, 55) on hover

hero_section_title.details: Hero displays 'Aristocratic Artwork Sale' in Playfair Display serif font

primary_button_gold_border.details: Primary buttons have gold border rgb(212, 175, 55), fill gold on hover with black text

secondary_button_subtle_border.details: Secondary buttons have subtle border rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.15), gold on hover

collections_landing_categories.details: 5 category cards displayed: Paintings, Jewelry, Watches, Statues, Decorative Arts with purple gradient backgrounds

category_cards_gold_icons.details: All category icons are gold rgb(212, 175, 55), CTA appears on hover with opacity transition

collections_filter_gold_active.details: Category filter buttons show gold border and text rgb(212, 175, 55) when active

footer_three_columns.details: Footer has 3 columns: brand (Aristocratic Artwork Sale), navigation (4 links), contact (email + 3 social icons)

music_toggle_functionality.details: Music toggle visible at bottom-left (x=24, y=1004), changes from muted (gray) to playing (gold) on click

consistent_dark_theme.details: All sections maintain dark theme - alternating between rgb(5, 5, 5) and rgb(13, 10, 16)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Dark theme redesign fully implemented. Color scheme: purple (#4B0082, #240046) and gold (#D4AF37). Typography: Playfair Display for headings, Cinzel for accents, Manrope for body. All hover effects working correctly. Music toggle persists state via sessionStorage. Cookie consent banner must be accepted first on fresh visits.
